caption: The drawing features a single wooden stool, positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The stool has three legs and a seat that is shaped like a half-circle or semicircle, all rendered in a reddish-brown color suggesting a wood material. The seat is supported by three vertical legs, with the front two legs connected by two horizontal braces and a diagonal brace forming a triangular support structure beneath the seat. The composition is minimalist, with no additional objects or decorative elements present in the drawing. Shadows underneath the legs suggest a light source coming from the upper left.
title: Shaker Music Rack
